title: Engram bootstrap can be silently dropped if Codex honours config.developer_instructions over the top-level field
outcome:
Claude review session-6531, Low at src/codex_engram_bootstrap.rs:51.

When the base is taken from params.config.developer_instructions (lines 31-36),
the composed value is written ONLY to the top-level developerInstructions key.
THE UN-APPENDED COPY IS LEFT IN params.config.

TermAl's assumption that the top-level field outranks the config layer is pinned
only by TermAl's OWN test
(engram_bootstrap_composition_matches_override_precedence_and_null_inheritance),
not by any observed Codex behaviour. If Codex's precedence is the reverse, the
thread starts successfully and THE BOOTSTRAP IS SILENTLY DROPPED - a failure
with no error and no signal, which is the hardest kind to notice.

Latent today because the production mcp_config never sets developer_instructions.

FIX DIRECTION: overwrite or remove the config.developer_instructions copy so
both layers carry the same composed text regardless of which one Codex honours.
That removes the dependency on an assumption nobody has measured.
